_comment: LIVE page inventory for every Figma file the catalog tracks, harvested directly
from Figma rather than from figma.txt. This exists because the catalog's node lists are
parsed from that hand-maintained link dump, so any page never pasted into it is
structurally invisible - the root cause of every coverage gap found on 2026-07-28.
build-registry.mjs reads this to stamp `page` and `readiness` on every frame and to
REPORT pages that no section covers, so the next missing page announces itself.
readiness comes from the leading emoji of the page NAME, which is the convention the
team actually uses (Casey, 2026-07-28). Figma's real Dev Mode devStatus flag is not
readable here: the MCP plugin sandbox rejects the getter and get_metadata omits it.
liveChildren = count of TOP-LEVEL children on the page, including furniture
(Directory / Breakpoint / Rectangle N / Vector N), so it is NOT directly comparable
to a section's frame count. null means not counted. Counting REQUIRES
setCurrentPageAsync per page: an unloaded page reports children.length === 0 rather
than throwing, so a bulk read silently reports an empty file. Every count below was
taken with an explicit page switch.
★ 2026-07-29 RE-HARVEST. The design moved substantially overnight - see
`figmaChangeLog` at the bottom. Web App went 11 -> 13 pages, Games 13 -> 18, and
THREE pages were promoted to ready-for-dev (Predict, Chicken, Hi-Lo).
method: use_figma read-only: figma.root.children for the page list, then setCurrentPageAsync per page for children.length

2026-07-29.note: Re-harvest against the 2026-07-28 snapshot. The design moved a lot overnight; the catalog committed yesterday is stale by ~180 ready-for-dev frames.

promotedToReady.Predict: was 🚧 with 138 frames, now ✅ with 284 (+146). The single largest new ready-for-dev surface.

newPages.Titles + Emblems: 1,157 frames, 🚧. Almost certainly an asset/emblem library rather than screens - do NOT catalog as screens without checking.

shrank.Towers: 117 -> 63 (-54). Frames were DELETED, not added. Anything catalogued or built from the old set may now point at nodes that no longer resolve.

★ frameNamesAreUnreliableOnNewGamePages: The Darts, Chicken and Hi-Lo pages were duplicated from existing game pages and their
frame TITLES were never renamed. Darts contains frames literally named
'Skai > Play > Casino > Hi-Lo Start (1440 x 900px)' and
'Skai > Play > Casino > Blackjack (375 x 812px)'. Chicken contains the same two names.
Hi-Lo contains 'Skai > Play > Casino > Scratchers (768 x 1024px)'.
The PAGE name is the truth; the breadcrumb is a copy-paste artifact. This is exactly
why the Games file uses page-name grouping (NON_SKAI_SECTIONS) rather than the
title breadcrumb - but it also means a human or agent reading frame names will
build the WRONG GAME. Flagged to Casey 2026-07-29.

2026-08-18.note: Large upstream design update. Four Games pages became catalogable, six pages were promoted 🚧 -> ✅, and one page was renamed AND rebuilt. Nothing here was applied blind — see figma-todo.games.tsv / figma-todo.webapp-0818.tsv for the per-frame log.

newPages.Slide: 17 frames (9929:16391), born ready-for-dev (✅). The richest naming of the four — 'Extended LB', 'Auto Advanced', 'Mobile Auto Advanced' mirror the Crash page's vocabulary exactly.

promotedToReady.Baccarat: was 🚧 and EMPTY, now ✅ with 19 frames.
promotedToReady.Roulette: was 🚧 and EMPTY, now ✅ with 19 frames.
promotedToReady.Bingo: was 🚧 with 8 live children, now ✅ with 16.
promotedToReady.Rock Paper Scissors: was 🚧 with 6, now ✅ with 24 (+18) — and REBUILT: 5 of the old 6 ids retargeted from 9737-* to 9907-*.
promotedToReady.Price Grid: 🚧 -> ✅ (formerly the SKAI Cross page). See `renamed` below.

grew.Social: 161 -> 311 (+150). The largest single change in this pass; ~110 of the additions are mobile/tablet 'Skai > Play 1VH' frames drawn on the Social page.

shrank.Towers: 63 -> 48 (-15), and 4 frames were ADDED, so 19 ids stopped resolving. None of the 19 carried implFiles, notes or a triaged status. NOTE: the briefed figure for this pass was 46; the live count is 48. Measured, not assumed.

renamed.9660:2: '🚧 SKAI Cross - Skai originals' -> '✅ Price Grid - Skai originals'. NOT a cosmetic rename: the page contents were replaced wholesale (15 ids gone, 20 new, zero title matches), and SKAI Cross and Price Grid are two separate live games in Play.tsx. Catalogued as a NEW `price-grid` section; the old `skai-cross` section is kept as a tombstone. See unmappedSections.

★ correctionToThisFile: The outOfScope entries for Roulette and Baccarat ('Page exists but holds ZERO
frames — design has not started') were TRUE on 2026-08-13 and FALSE by
2026-08-18. They are removed. A measurement that is written down as a decision
does not expire on its own: for five days those two lines kept 38 real,
ready-for-dev frames structurally invisible to this catalog. When recording a
page as out of scope, record the DATE and the MEASUREMENT, not a verdict.

_reharvested:
2026-08-05 — full live re-harvest of BOTH files via PageNode.loadAsync (no page switching needed, unlike the 07-29 pass). 31 pages: 16 ready-for-dev, 10 under-construction, 5 meta. No new pages since 07-29.

2026-08-18 — targeted live re-harvest of 25 sections across all three files (setCurrentPageAsync per page; every returned count verified against the count seen when listing the page). Skai-Games went 22 -> 24 pages. Drift was logged BEFORE anything was overwritten: figma-todo.games.tsv and figma-todo.webapp-0818.tsv.

outOfScope.🚧 Titles + Emblems: Not SKAI screens. A 1,157-node REFERENCE board for a future titles/emblems system: badge tiles at 188x40 / 67x64, node names 'image 2'..'image N', and descriptions copied verbatim from Call of Duty achievements ("Complete the 'Collateral Damage' challenge. Kill 2 or more enemies with a single sniper rifle bullet"). Zero frames match a screen convention. This is the same 'examples of what the reporter likes' material Casey flagged 2026-08-05 — inspiration, not a spec. Re-scope only if SKAI authors its own emblem screens.

unmappedSections.skai-cross: TOMBSTONE. Figma page 9660:2 was renamed '🚧 SKAI Cross' -> '✅ Price Grid' on 2026-08-18 and its contents replaced wholesale: all 15 catalogued ids are gone and the 20 now on the page share no title with any of them. Those 20 are Price Grid designs and are catalogued under the separate `price-grid` section, because SKAI Cross and Price Grid are two SEPARATE LIVE GAMES (Play.tsx mounts SkaiCrossGame at :1610 and PriceGridGame at :1625, each with its own id, art, accent and feature flag). The 15 rows are KEPT — recorded `gone` in bugref-aliases.tsv — so nothing is deleted. ★ The consequence worth acting on: SKAI Cross is a SHIPPING game that now has NO Figma page at all.
